title: Harbison Protection Contracts Desk Note: The Claim Service Fee per Service Visit
content:
**The rule.** A claim service fee on Harbison Protection Contracts is charged once per service visit on which at least one claim is approved or partially approved, no matter how many claims or contracts that visit involves. A visit whose claims are all denied carries no fee. Only one claim service fee is charged per service visit.

**Visits involving several contracts.** When approved claims on one visit fall under contracts with different fees, the former clause stating that "the single fee is the highest of their claim service fee values" is **no longer in force**; it has been superseded by the current basis for fixing the claim service fee. The fee is charged on the contract carrying it and names the first approved claim of the visit.

**When no fee is charged.**

- No fee is charged when that fee is $0.00.
- None is charged for a no-lemon unit replacement on a tier whose schedule waives the claim service fee on the replacement.
- The fee is waived when the holder held a Comfort Club agreement in active status on the visit's completed date at a Comfort Club tier that waives the warranty claim fee. A waived fee is not charged at all, and a fee already charged in error is reversed by a service fee waiver credit naming it.

**Collection.** The fee is due with the service invoice, and an unpaid fee never suspends coverage.

**Evidence.** Whether a claim service fee already stands for a visit is read from the contract's billing history: a claim service fee charge naming that service visit. The waiver is read from the company's records — the holder's Comfort Club agreement, its status and tier, and the service visit's completed date — never from a statement alone.

**Points of judgement (hypothetical visits).**

| Claims decided on the visit | Claim service fee charged for the visit |
|---|---|
| two claims, one approved and one denied | one fee |
| three claims, all approved | one fee |
| two claims, both denied | none |
| an approved claim, holder in an active Comfort Club agreement at a fee-waiving tier on the completed date | none (waived) |
| an approved claim on a visit that already carries a claim service fee charge | no second fee |

superseded_clauses: the single fee is the highest of their claim_service_fee_usd values
